checks.description: scripts/changed-areas.sh marca solo las áreas que tocan los archivos cambiados, y todas si cambia .github/ o no hay base
checks.cmd:
s="$PWD/scripts/changed-areas.sh"; t=$(mktemp -d); cd "$t" && git init -q && k() { git add -A && git -c user.name=t -c user.email=t@t commit -q --allow-empty -m "$1"; } && k root && mkdir web && touch web/a && k web && w=$("$s" HEAD~1 | sort | tr '
' ' ') && mkdir .github && touch .github/a && k dotgithub && g=$("$s" HEAD~1 | sort | tr '
' ' ') && n=$("$s" "" | sort | tr '
' ' '); cd / && rm -rf "$t"; echo "web: $w| github: $g| none: $n"
checks.assert: stdout~^web: api=false smoke=true tools=false web=true workflows=false \| github: api=true smoke=true tools=true web=true workflows=true \| none: api=true smoke=true tools=true web=true workflows=true $

checks.description: ci.yml corre en pull_request, en merge_group y en push a main
checks.cmd: yq '(.on | keys | sort | join(",")) + " push=" + (.on.push.branches // [] | join(","))' .github/workflows/ci.yml

checks.description: El job changes de ci.yml calcula las áreas con scripts/changed-areas.sh contra la base del PR, de la cola o del push, con el historial completo
checks.cmd: yq '.jobs.changes | ([.steps[].env.BASE // ""] | join("")) as $b | "outputs=" + (.outputs // {} | keys | sort | join(",")) + " depth=" + ([.steps[] | select(.uses // "" | test("^actions/checkout@")) | .with."fetch-depth"] | join(",")) + " script=" + ([.steps[] | select(.run // "" | test("scripts/changed-areas\.sh \"\$BASE\".*GITHUB_OUTPUT"))] | length | tostring) + " base=" + (($b | test("pull_request\.base\.sha")) and ($b | test("merge_group\.base_sha")) and ($b | test("event\.before")) | tostring)' .github/workflows/ci.yml

checks.description: ci.yml llama a ci-api, ci-web, ci-tools, smoke y lint-workflows como reutilizables, cada uno solo si su área cambia
checks.cmd: yq '[.jobs | to_entries | .[] | select(.value.uses // "" | test("^\./\.github/workflows/")) | select((.value.if // "") == "needs.changes.outputs." + .key + " == '"'"'true'"'"'") | .key + ":" + (.value.uses | sub(".*/"; "") | sub("\.yml$"; ""))] | sort | join(" ")' .github/workflows/ci.yml

checks.description: ci-api, ci-web, ci-tools, smoke y lint-workflows solo se disparan por workflow_call o a mano, y sin concurrency propia
checks.cmd: for f in ci-api ci-web ci-tools smoke lint-workflows; do printf '%s=%s ' "$f" "$(yq '(.on | keys | sort | join(",")) + (if has("concurrency") then ":concurrency" else "" end)' .github/workflows/$f.yml)"; done

checks.description: ci-gate corre siempre, sin permisos, después de todos los jobs de ci.yml salvo runner-info y summary
checks.cmd: yq '.jobs."ci-gate" | "if=" + (.if // "" | test("always[(][)]") | tostring) + " perms=" + (.permissions | tag) + ":" + (.permissions | length | tostring) + " needs=" + (.needs // [] | sort | join(","))' .github/workflows/ci.yml

checks.description: ci-gate pasa si todo terminó en success o skipped, y falla si algún job falló o se canceló
checks.cmd: r=$(yq '.jobs."ci-gate".steps[-1].run' .github/workflows/ci.yml); g() { RESULTS="$1" bash -c "$r" >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo pass || echo block; }; echo "ok=$(g '["success","skipped"]') failure=$(g '["success","failure"]') cancelled=$(g '["cancelled","success"]')"

checks.description: pr-report.yml escucha a ci y solo comenta cuando el run trae el artefacto dist-report
checks.cmd: yq '"from=" + (.on.workflow_run.workflows | join(",")) + " guarded=" + ([.jobs[].steps[] | select(.if // "" | test("steps\.")) ] | length | tostring)' .github/workflows/pr-report.yml

checks.description: actionlint y zizmor pasan sin hallazgos sobre los workflows de tablero
CODEOWNERS asigna dueño a /.github/ y a /ops/
ops/github/ruleset-main.yaml protege la rama por defecto sin excepciones: sin borrado ni force push, PR obligatorio sin aprobaciones, ci-gate de GitHub Actions como check y merge queue
checks.cmd: yq -o=json ops/github/ruleset-main.yaml | jq -r '"target=\(.target) \(.enforcement) ref=\(.conditions.ref_name.include | join(",")) bypass=\(.bypass_actors | length) rules=\([.rules[].type] | sort | join(",")) approvals=\(.rules[] | select(.type == "pull_request") | .parameters.required_approving_review_count) checks=\([.rules[] | select(.type == "required_status_checks") | .parameters.required_status_checks[] | "\(.context)@\(.integration_id)"] | join(","))"'
checks.assert: stdout~^target=branch active ref=~DEFAULT_BRANCH bypass=0 rules=deletion,merge_queue,non_fast_forward,pull_request,required_status_checks approvals=0 checks=ci-gate@15368$

checks.description: El job release-please de release.yml no da permisos a GITHUB_TOKEN y usa un token de la GitHub App, limitado a contents y pull-requests, desde el environment release
checks.cmd: yq -o=json '.jobs."release-please"' .github/workflows/release.yml | jq -r '. as $j | ([.steps[] | select(.uses // "" | test("^actions/create-github-app-token@[0-9a-f]{40}$"))][0]) as $a | "perms=\(.permissions | tojson) env=\(.environment) client=\($a.with."client-id") key=\($a.with."private-key") scope=\([$a.with | to_entries[] | select(.key | startswith("permission-")) | "\(.key)=\(.value)"] | sort | join(",")) token=\([.steps[] | select(.uses // "" | test("^googleapis/release-please-action@")) | .with.token] | join(""))" | gsub(" "; "")'

checks.description: La rama main de tablero tiene activas las reglas del ruleset, con ci-gate de GitHub Actions como check obligatorio
checks.cmd: gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}/rules/branches/main --jq '"rules=\([.[].type] | unique | join(",")) checks=\([.[] | select(.type == "required_status_checks") | .parameters.required_status_checks[] | "\(.context)@\(.integration_id)"] | join(","))"'

checks.description: GitHub no encuentra errores en el CODEOWNERS de tablero
Ni la organización ni tablero dejan que GITHUB_TOKEN cree o apruebe pull requests
El environment release solo admite main y guarda la clave privada y el client ID de la App
checks.cmd: printf 'branches=%s secrets=%s vars=%s' "$(gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}/environments/release/deployment-branch-policies --jq '[.branch_policies[] | .type + "/" + .name] | join(",")')" "$(gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}/environments/release/secrets --jq '[.secrets[].name] | join(",")')" "$(gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}/environments/release/variables --jq '[.variables[].name] | join(",")')"

checks.description: El PR del último commit de main pasó ci-gate en la merge queue y ci volvió a pasar en el push a main
checks.cmd: git fetch -q origin main && sha=$(git rev-parse origin/main) && n=$(gh api "repos/{owner}/{repo}/commits/$sha/pulls" --jq '.[0].number') && printf 'queue=%s push=%s' "$(gh run list --workflow ci.yml --event merge_group --limit 50 --json headBranch,conclusion --jq "[.[] | select(.headBranch | test(\"/pr-$n(-|\$)\"))][0].conclusion")" "$(gh run list --workflow ci.yml --event push --commit "$sha" --json conclusion --jq '.[0].conclusion')"

checks.description: El último PR de release lo abrió la GitHub App, no GITHUB_TOKEN, y ci-gate corrió en verde sobre él
checks.cmd: gh pr list --state merged --label 'autorelease: tagged' --limit 1 --json author,headRefOid --jq '.[0] | "\(.author.login) \(.headRefOid)"' | { read -r who sha; printf 'bot=%s gate=%s' "$([[ $who == app/* && $who != app/github-actions ]] && echo app || echo "$who")" "$(gh api "repos/{owner}/{repo}/commits/$sha/check-runs?check_name=ci-gate" --jq '[.check_runs[].conclusion] | first')"; }
